login.title: Log in
login.description: Use a Love 21 demo account or your own registered account.
login.intro: Sign in to continue your Love 21 journey. Choose the account type that best describes you, then use your email and password.
login.accountTypeHelp: Not sure? Choose the closest option. We'll send you to the right account after login.
login.staffModeNote: Staff access is kept separate from the public account picker. Your permissions still come from the role returned by the backend after login.
login.selectToOpenForm: Select Supporter or Member to open the sign-in form.
login.chooseToContinue: Choose an account type to continue. Browsing, donating, and volunteering remain open without logging in.
login.chooseAccountError: Choose an account type to continue.

supporter.label: Supporter
supporter.description: I donate, volunteer, or support Love 21 activities.

member.label: Member
member.description: I take part in Love 21 programmes.

admin.label: Staff
admin.description: Manage donations, wishlist needs, campaigns, and site operations.

register.title: Create account
register.description: Join Love 21 as a supporter or member.
register.descriptionLong: Accounts are optional and only for managing ongoing Love 21 involvement. Public browsing, one-off donations, and initial volunteer sign-up stay open without login.
register.supporterDesc: Track your giving, volunteering, activities, and impact in one place.

notAuthorized.title: Not authorized
notAuthorized.description: You don't have permission to view this page.
notAuthorized.descriptionLong: Your account does not have access to this page. If this looks wrong, please contact Love 21 staff.
notAuthorized.loginDifferent: Log in with a different account

portal.redirectSupporter: Volunteer and donor accounts are now supporter accounts. Redirecting to your supporter dashboard…
portal.redirectDonor: Donor and volunteer accounts are now supporter accounts. Redirecting to your supporter dashboard…
portal.volunteerDesc: Your volunteer dashboard will appear here.
portal.volunteerTrackDesc: Initial volunteer sign-up stays public. This signed-in portal is for volunteers who opt in to track ongoing involvement.
portal.donorDesc: Your giving history and impact will appear here.
portal.donorRecurringDesc: One-off giving remains public. This signed-in portal is for donors who opt in to manage ongoing support.
portal.donorLoadError: Could not load recurring donation tools
portal.profileDesc: Update your contact details for Love 21 programmes.
portal.memberManageDesc: This protected page is for stateful member profile management. Programme browsing and joining information remain public.
